title.en: Find the Dog in the Photo

brief.zh: 把两张照片分别交给本地 YOLOX，核对框出的区域和模型给出的类别。
brief.en: Give two photos to the local YOLOX model. Check the regions it marks and the categories it predicts.

concept.zh: 模型输出的类别对应照片中的一个位置。
concept.en: A model's predicted class is attached to a location in the photo.

hints.zh: 选择“全部类别”看完整的检测输出，再按类别筛选。
hints.en: Choose All classes to view the detection output, then filter by class.

prompt.zh: 运行检测。在框里找到模型认出的目标，再把类别切到“人”试试。
prompt.en: Run detection and locate the object in its box. Then try filtering to the Person class.

prompt.zh: 用同样的设置看另一张照片，找找模型在框上写了什么。
prompt.en: Use the same settings with a second photo and read the label on the box.
